attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Rhode Island state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 3 brackets per RI Division of Taxation (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Rhode Island Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ri_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: Calculate RI tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ri_standard_deduction_single sub result.ri_personal_exemption sub 0 max dup /ri_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ri_tax xdef
ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_1_limit min result.ri_bracket_1_rate mul /ri_tax xdef
ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_1_limit gt { ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_2_limit min result.ri_bracket_1_limit sub result.ri_bracket_2_rate mul ri_tax add /ri_tax xdef } if
ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_2_limit gt { ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_2_limit sub result.ri_bracket_3_rate mul ri_tax add /ri_tax xdef } if
ri_tax /result.ri_state_tax xdef ri_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Rhode Island tax calculated (Single): $" result.ri_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate RI tax for Married Filing Jointly using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ri_standard_deduction_joint sub result.ri_personal_exemption 2 mul sub 0 max dup /ri_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ri_tax xdef
ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_1_limit min result.ri_bracket_1_rate mul /ri_tax xdef
ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_1_limit gt { ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_2_limit min result.ri_bracket_1_limit sub result.ri_bracket_2_rate mul ri_tax add /ri_tax xdef } if
ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_2_limit gt { ri_taxable_income result.ri_bracket_2_limit sub result.ri_bracket_3_rate mul ri_tax add /ri_tax xdef } if
ri_tax /result.ri_state_tax xdef ri_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Rhode Island tax calculated (MFJ): $" result.ri_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Rhode Island military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption since 2023 (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_postfix: "RI Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto
initial_action.action_comment: Initialize RI military retirement exclusion calculation

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from RI taxable income (since 2023)
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay get /result.ri_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.ri_subtractions get result.ri_military_retirement_exclusion get add /result.ri_subtractions xdef
"RI Military Retirement Exclusion (Full since 2023): $" result.ri_military_retirement_exclusion get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.ri_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "RI Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
